project.name: QuotePilot by MBMApps
project.primaryPurpose: Turn catering demand into governed quotes, customer decisions, payments, and event operations without blurring evidence boundaries.
project.economicBuyer: catering business owner or operating administrator
project.problemSolved: Replace fragmented quote-to-event work with tenant-scoped pricing, exact revisions, customer decisions, payment evidence, and operational handoff.
project.stage: v0.15.0 deployed to both governed production targets with incomplete production acceptance
project.primaryDeploymentTarget: Vercel public edge plus Firebase Hosting, Functions, Firestore rules, and indexes

goals.statement: Keep pricing, tenancy, identity, and provider effects server-authoritative and fail closed.
Let an operator move one event from inquiry through quote, decision, payment, and operational handoff with explicit state.
Make release, provider, and acceptance evidence independently inspectable.
Establish repeatable buyer activation, real usage, and revenue evidence; current proof is UNVERIFIED.

journeys.name: Catering inquiry to operational handoff
journeys.trigger: A catering demand or event opportunity requires a governed quote.
journeys.stateChange: Tenant quote, version, proposal, decision, payment-evidence, and operational-artifact states advance through their own authorities.
journeys.authorityOrEvidence: Firebase Functions, tenant catalog authority, exact revision receipts, portal decision evidence, provider webhooks, and revision-bound operational artifacts.
journeys.nextState: An exact accepted/booked event has explicit payment and operational handoff evidence.
journeys.outcome: An operator can execute one event without treating browser state or missing provider evidence as authority.

journeys.name: Buyer purchase to tenant activation
journeys.trigger: A prospective catering operator requests paid product access.
journeys.stateChange: A verified buyer identity becomes an explicitly provisioned tenant owner with configured pricing authority.
journeys.authorityOrEvidence: Stripe test-mode invoice evidence, signed webhook reconciliation, exact-email activation, and Firebase owner/tenant receipts.
journeys.nextState: The buyer can begin the primary quote-to-operations journey.
journeys.outcome: A buyer activates without developer intervention; hosted and commercial proof remain UNVERIFIED.

decisions.statement: Browser state never establishes pricing, tenancy, provider acceptance, settlement, or operational readiness.
Commercial changes and customer decisions bind to exact saved revisions and immutable receipts.
Ambient exact arrival uses a bounded semantic URL/history hybrid with destination focus proof.
Stripe Connect remains isolated, provider disabled, and unexported until its infrastructure and hosted evidence gates pass.
Source, local tests, CI, deployment, provider outcomes, recipient behavior, human acceptance, and commercial proof are separate claims.

integrations.name: Firebase Auth, Firestore, Functions, and Hosting
Stripe payments and isolated Connect program

risks.statement: Exact v0.15.0 deployment can be mistaken for tenant availability, provider outcomes, recipient behavior, human acceptance, or commercial proof.
risks.mitigation: Keep the exact deployment receipts separate and leave each missing downstream evidence class UNVERIFIED.

risks.statement: Large source and test coverage can be mistaken for provider, production, human, or commercial proof.
risks.mitigation: Keep evidence types explicit and fail unverified claims closed.

risks.statement: Many gated source programs increase reconciliation and adoption cost.
risks.mitigation: Fund work through one observable next proof event and retire or defer programs that do not reduce its uncertainty.

blockers.statement: Tenant 250 lacks organizations/250/settings/config, so the protected staffing activation workflow failed closed without mutation.
blockers.resolutionCondition: A reviewed tenant-scoped migration provisions the canonical settings document and the protected activation workflow records exact verified readback.

blockers.statement: No current authenticated end-to-end production staff acceptance receipt exists.
blockers.resolutionCondition: An authorized staff operator completes the defined production matrix on the exact deployed release with role, tenant, revision, portal-denial, and BEO receipts.

blockers.statement: Exact email and coordinated payment provider acceptance remain unverified.
blockers.resolutionCondition: Exact provider receipts establish proposal-email acceptance and both hosted payment rails without inferring delivery, recipient behavior, or settlement.

blockers.statement: Buyer access needs a dedicated restricted test key, webhook checks, Turnstile checks, and bounded hosted acceptance.
blockers.resolutionCondition: Restricted test credentials, exact webhook inventory, both production-hostname Turnstile checks, and bounded hosted buyer acceptance pass.

blockers.statement: Connect lacks an approved applied staging foundation, trusted runtime binding, and hosted Sandbox proof.
blockers.resolutionCondition: An explicitly approved isolated staging plan is applied and reconciled, then authenticated hosted Stripe Sandbox UAT produces the bounded evidence package.

blockers.statement: Steward lacks a reviewed provider transport and consenting silent-pilot human comparison evidence.
blockers.resolutionCondition: Provider transport, consent, private persistence, and human-comparison protocol are approved before a bounded silent pilot records non-authoritative evidence.

blockers.statement: Paid customers, recurring usage, revenue, retention, and buyer acceptance are UNVERIFIED in repository evidence.
blockers.resolutionCondition: Direct buyer, activation, paid-customer, repeated-usage, retention, revenue, and measured-outcome evidence is recorded without deriving it from source activity.

proofEvents.title: Exact v0.15.0 authenticated quote-to-operations production journey
proofEvents.hypothesis: After reviewed tenant provisioning and protected staffing activation, one authorized operator can complete the primary quote-to-operations journey on exact v0.15.0 without authority or evidence gaps.
proofEvents.whyItMatters: It reduces uncertainty across five high-value cohorts with one observable operator journey while keeping provider and recipient proof separate.
preconditions: run an approved tenant-250 provisioning migration and activate staffing only after verified readback
proofEvents.observableEvent: One authorized tenant-250 operator creates and saves an exact quote revision, reopens it, issues the current proposal, records a customer decision, and generates the revision-bound BEO while role and cross-tenant denials remain intact.
acceptanceCriteria: exact release SHA and Firebase deployment receipt
cross-tenant and invalid portal paths fail closed
provider and recipient outcomes remain separately labeled when absent
requiredEvidence: tenant settings and protected activation readback
